nom: SUNDAY RILEY A+ High-Dose Retinoid Serum

avis.texte: This product reversed the progress I made with Roc nighttime retinol. My laugh lines came right back while using. I wanted to finish the product because of the price tag but I should have pitched it. Save yourself some money and heartache and get a different brand. The only positive thing is it was pretty moisturizing. However, that's probably because it's not anti-aging in the slightest.

I used this entire bottle before reviewing. I applied every night and never got any redness or peeling because this product doesn't work at all. I took a photo og my face before and after, no change. I started usng a different retinol product (from LaRoche Posay) and within a week noticed some redness and peeling. My skin looks noticeably different and feels smooth with the new product. Don't waste your money on Sunday Riley.

avis.titre: Way too strong of a retinol base for me
avis.texte: I have used the Sunday Riley Sleeping Oil that contains retinol on my neck nightly for months now with no issues. I thought I would try and switch to this stronger retinol blend but it really irritated my neck, causing bumps and a burning sensation. This may be a good product for those already used to using stronger retinol products.

avis.titre: Fountain of youth in a bottle
avis.texte: I've been using the following regime since early December 2025 Cleansers & exfoliators (3 alternating days): Day 1: Kate Somerville EradiKate 3% Sulfer foaming cleaner Day 2: Kate Somerville "on the glow" set - - this is good for starting off. You wash with the cleanser, follow with the exfoliator (don't leave it on long) and follow with moisturizer (I use the moisturizer every day) Day 3: Naturium KP Body Scrub and Mask (you can use this on your face and body) Evening regime: Naturium Azelaic Topical Acid 10% (apply thin layer - - helps with any blemishes and gentle exfoliator overnight; wait for it to dry a little before next product) Sunday Riley A+ High-Dose Retinoid Serum (again, apply a thin layer; I started with a small bottle; this one is pricey but does most of the work and is SO worth it imho!)

it's very, very good and unfortunately worth the price. make sure to lock in with a good moisturizer and use as directed- not every day at first, especially if you have sensitive skin, as it will lead to peeling.

avis.titre: Let this be your one skincare splurge
avis.texte: This review is not sponsored! This stuff is the TRUTH! Let me start off by saying I have VERY dry, sensitive-ish (but exercised) skin. I used this a few years back and I had poreless, clear, (almost) line free, glowing, even skin. I went out looking for something else because of the absurd price point of this product. I have tried retinoids/retinols/retinals from all different brands and price points to try to find something less expensive that worked…nope. All of them made me so dry and peely to the point that everytime I even WASHED my face, it stung horribly. This product in particular has a lot of buffers/hydrating ingredients in it to keep the retinoids in it from being super irritating. Begrudgingly, I picked this up from Ulta a few days ago and have used it twice since then. Pores have completely diminished, clear, glowing, lines are less visible, my skin isn't angrily peeling. I now remember what justified me to spend $100< /> a bottle in the first place

I have bought some other Sunday Riley and was in the market for a new retinol. This one is not it. The amount is only .5 oz, in a bottle that looks like much more. It also has an odd plastic-y odor that I could ignore, but wasn't pleasant.

This is easily the best OTC retinoid I've tried. My skin doesn't purge when I start and stop using it, it doesn't wreck my skin barrier or give me dry patches, and it basically eliminates texture and fine lines. The price is steep so I usually only buy it when it's on sale, but I would pay full price if I ran out.

Got some samples of this and was excited to try it but I couldn't leave the product on my face for more than a couple of minutes and had to wash it off. It smells like BO/feet and I just can't. Maybe I got a bad sample but I saw another review like mine so had to share.

I can't even give an honest review about this product's potency or lackthereof because I don't even think I got 4 uses out of it (not lying!). This was not a sample size. I paid for this "Full Size" product. I ordered it online, so I know it wasn't a product I bought from the shelf that was used and then accidentally sold. I knew how many ounces I purchased, so I had/have a round about idea of how long this product should have lasted me. I'm so disappointed because the ounces definitely did not match up with the promised label. I thought maybe the pump was broken, so I opened it. Nope; not broken. Just an empty bottle. I could not return it because the whole bottle was used up, and they were not going to believe that I was actually telling the truth, so I was just out the money. Beware of this if you purchase.
I love Sunday Riley's products. The retinoid A+ works great. Love my skin after using this product. My skin is usually sensitive to products but Sunday Riley has been a win win for me.

Im a very expirienced (20+ years) person when it comes to retinols and chemical peels. This stuff is simply the best. Its strong and yet very gentle on my skin. It completly errased very fine lines on my forehead and helps my skin to stay sun spots free. Highly highly recomend!

I've been using this product for over a year and can truly say it has been a game changer for me. It has eliminated the gross filaments on my nose and helps with blemishes that try to erupt. It's also helps with hyperpigmentation. The fragrance is not great, but I can live with it considering the fantastic job it does for my skin. Give it a go…

Tried so many products to try and get rid of my awful breakout across my forehead and down my cheeks...nothing worked ! Tried Sunday Rileys A+ High Dose Retinoid Serum and not even a WEEK later completely cleared up. Recommend this to everyone.

Got it on the 21 days sale. I read it helps with clogged pores (Which was my main reason for purchasing) and fine line/wrinkes,redness… so i decided to give it a shot and turned out to be the BEST product I have purchased. You do see result. Really good stuff. Will continue to pruchase from now on.

This is truly I product I didn't know I needed. I saw it on sale during Ulta's 21-days of beauty and I'm so glad I took a chance on it. It has done wonders on my complexion, redness, dryness and dark spots. I had a rough area on my temple and it was gone after one application! I don't have terrible skin to begin with and I do have sensitive skin with some rosacea. I have been tolerating this serum well using the two days on/two days off method and likely will keep up that routine instead of using this everyday given my sensitivity. Based on the reviews looks like it is hit or miss if your skin can handle it. I'm so glad I had to sense to buy two during the sale but now I'm annoyed that I love it so much because it's definitely not a cheap product.
This is the best retinol serum I've ever used. Goes on silky and absorbs beautifully. I've noticed even my deep forehead wrinkles have faded substantially. Would recommend to everyone!

I want to love it but the smell is so bad for me that even if this product worked, I would never buy again. I will continue to use it until finished bottle to see any results. If they can change that scent or take away the ingredient is causing the bad smell would be great.

avis.titre: I would buy over and over again
avis.texte: Ever since I have started using this product, my skin has been glowing and has stopped breaking out. I feel like my skin finally is starting to look radiant and more useful. Love this product.

avis.titre: Amazing night oil - So glad I found this
avis.texte: This is a "throw your other products away" kind of product. I love the way this works and feels. I really like putting on night oils but usually they are just hydrating. This one works so well, after one day my face looked softer. After a week pores were smaller, more uniform color and wrinkles less noticeable. It gets the deep blue color from blue tansy oil which is a very good essential oil for skin. The german chamomile is also nice.

Only had this serum for a week, but I can already tell a huge difference in my skin! It has cleared up my acne and made my skin texture much smoother. Can't wait to see long term results. I will be buying this again!

I was so hopeful that this would help with my aging skin, especially after reading so much about how great Sunday Riley products are. I wanted to try a gentler alternative to the retinal I was using which is a stronger version of retinol. Unfortunately this was not only stronger but it gave me a horrible reaction. I woke up with a painful blotchy rash over my entire face, neck and chest. In addition to that I had new wrinkles under my eyes even though I didn't apply any there, so it must have migrated. Not sure if this was an allergic reaction or this was just a very strong formulation.
This burned and broke out my skin, be very careful if you're using this. I had to return and DO NOT recommend .
A+ keeps my skin smooth and clear. I use it in my nighly routine 5x a week with Luna oil. It works wonders!

Not gone lie this is so bomb I wanted to gate keep lol but everyone deserves this skin love!!! The retinal is potent and intense but not irritating to the skin. This serum just create the luminous glow and I can't even imagine how life was prior to

I've been using A+ for a couple years and although I've tried a few others, nothing compares! I use every night after cleansing and before moisturizer, and have definitely noticed a visible difference and improvement in my aging skin. I can't imagine using any other retinol. Elegant packaging just tops off the whole experience. Believe me, once you use it, you'll never go back to anything else! Well done, SR!!
I wanted to like this as it helped with my crows feet, but, i couldnt get past the smell and it made my eyes tear up from burn& tear!

I received this as a sample which lasted s month or so a little goes a long way. I started seeing my wrinkle line near my mouth gradually going away when Ulta had it on sale I bought the mini. I use it daily at night it works great and worth every penny. My fine lines are diminishing.

I wanted to Love this product but I cannot get past the smell!!! Prior to purchase I did quite a bit of research and so many people claimed they either loved the smell, said it was a natual/earthy smell, or said it had a slight smell but nothing bothersome, but personally I can't handle it!! To me it smells like old mop water or an old wash rag! 🤢🤮 I will say that I am sensitive with smells but usually only fragrance type smells. This one is just gross! I left it on hoping it would dissipate over night but it still smelled just as bad in the morning. I tried it a second time mixed with one of my moisturizers that has a slight scent but it didn't help with the smell of the A+. Sadly I will be passing this product on to a friend and never purchasing again.

I always struggled with textured skin, large pores and rough feeling skin, constantly having to exfoliate with harsh washes and peeling pads. But since I started using this product I not done any of those. My skin feels and looks so smooth!
This is my second bottle. Has addressed several issues of aging skin like dark spots etc. people now ask me what skin care I'm using and give me compliments.
Another winning product from Sunday! So easy to apply and incredibly gentle on the skin.
So glad to finally invest in this. One of the best retinols on the market. Just the right amount to keep my skin from becoming aggravated.

bummed I got the am and pm kits. after I finish all the SR products because they are stupid expensive, I don't plan on purchasing them again. the consistency and scent of A+ is about on par with Cerave retinol serum, which I live. and it's a fraction of the price.

avis.titre: Better exists - This is not it
avis.texte: There are other more economically friendly products I've tried that deliver better results.

avis.titre: A+, just what we always wanted!
avis.texte: Fine lines are diminishing in just a few weeks as I added A+ to my night time skin care. I use in combination with Luna it is soothing and penetrates well. Follow up with Good Genes which can put a "tingle" in my skin! So very leased with results and grateful to have a simple to follow regimen ...that works!

I received my serum a week ago and upon opening the box, noticed yellow serum all inside the packaging and outside of the bottle. THE LID WAS NOT TIGHTENED. Given how expensive this is (and how half of it was lathered on everything except my face), I emailed Ulta. I received a response saying they would get back to me in 48 hours. 5 days later I sent a follow-up email. Now it has been 7 days and I havent heard a thing! This is ridiculous!

best otc retinol I've tried. BE AWARE & RESEARCH before blaming the product. This is one of the strongest types of retinol you can get before tret & if you aren't used to it or/have sensitive skin look for basic retinol& work up to this first:)

So im a product junkie. I spend quite a bit on all kinds of serums, moisturizers etc. I could never say "this product is my favorite" until now. I'm 54 and have seen a dramatic change in my skin's appearance. My skin feels plump, tight and smooth. I can honestly say that this product is worth the money. Now, i must warn you that ive had a few breakouts. Not full on acne but a whitehead pop up here and there. But ive done my research and learned that initial use of retinol can cause skin purging. Don't give up on a product that is doing its job, even if the initial response isnt what anyone of us wants. I highly recommend this product!

I started with a gentle cerave retinol and was looking to bump it up to help tackle acne scarring and uneven skintone. I have loved this enough to repurchase 3x now. I have definitely noticed a difference and feel like I'm setting myself up for success havign this in my routine.
I absolutely love this serum! I use it each nihht and have noticed a drastic difference in my skin. Fades dark spots, acne scars, and helps with fine lines.

avis.titre: Holy Grail In My Beauty Routine
avis.texte: So I've been using this product for maybe 3 years now, consistently using it almost every night for the last 2 years. I cannot rave about it enough. I have sensitive skin, and this isn't irritate it. I had smiles lines, they're now gone. Definitely buy!

I'm not quite sure where all the great reviews are coming from. For the price, I haven't seen a single bit of difference and it smells absolutely awful! The entire line of the products do for that matter. So extremely disappointed and annoyed for having invested my money in trying this line.
I'm not sure if I got a different product than everyone else in the reviews but this product did 0 for my skin. It's hydrating, great, but as far as doing anything else? Nothing.
I have used this product since I was told I had pre-cancerous skin care on my forehead. Since I began using this my dermatologist has not said anything about the spots that were supposedly a problem.

This and Luna Oil are my constant bedtime routine. It is not harsh as some retinol can be and it truly has awakened my dull skin. I've been using for only a few months and I will never change products.

I've tried Curology, The ordinary, and pretty much every other skin care product and brand for acne and this one actually worked! This retinol combination targets your skins' regeneration, fixes blemishes and clears pores. I saw a change in my skin after 2 weeks. I stopped buying for a month because it got expensive, black heads and acne came back. As soon as I bought this again, a week later my skin was back to clear! Worth the $$.

Getting my skin to be consistently clear and healthy has been a journey - one filled with prescriptions and countless OTC options. From the moment I tried this product I was impressed. My skin tolerated it well, no peeling and felt incredible soft. I have zero cons and recommend this to anyone wanting to improve their complexion. I have also raved about this to all my friends and tell you all to run to try it!

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again!
avis.texte: I used this serum with their oil and my skin looks so so good!

avis.titre: Fountain of Youth has been found!
avis.texte: I'm over 50 and wanted that smooth look when I wear foundation but my laugh lines and pores are so exaggerated. This product applied in just days has noticeably smoothed my skin. I haven't had any flakey or dryness. Definitely my new fav product!

avis.titre: The best retinol on the market
avis.texte: I am always a little nervous trying new products because I have spent lots of money in the past with no results. I have been using Sunday Riley for 2 months and added the Luna oil and the A+ retinoid to my routine. I had no issues with sensitivity and have seen such a huge healthy transition in my aging skin

avis.titre: Second time buying, time will tell
avis.texte: I switched to this retinol from cerave. Wanted something stronger, since cerave refuses to tell the percentage of retinol in their products. So far, so good. I've been a little lax with my application, though. Since I'm used to retinol, I normally apply nightly. If I miss applications, I start to get little pimples on my forehead. Hopefully those will go away now that I'm applying regularly.
I got a sample in the mail from a Facebook offer. It is now going to be a must have for me.

I'm 41 and have very damaged skin and large pores. I have tried so many different things, to no avail...this product is amazing! I've been using it every other day for a month and whoa! my skin is smooth and poreless! highly recommend

Now that aging skin is a major concern for me, this has become a very important product in my skin care regime. Retinol is essential for aging skin and this delivers with none of the down sides of retinol use.

I started using this product 3 or 4 years ago when I was having issues with my skin from blemishes to uneven skin tone. This product is an absolute miracle worker, once your skin gets used to it, you can add Luna oil on top- which just enhances the products!

avis.titre: One of my favorites A+ Retinoid
avis.texte: I love to mix A+ Retinoid, Good genes, and Luna oil to my evening routine and that makes my skin looks and feels more alive.

I've been using this for 3 months and I can finally see a difference. Don't give up!! My skin is so smooth and even now. The smell isn't the best, but it goes away fast, absorbs quickly and spreads easily
Finally a retinol serum that works and leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth.Love this product!!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Best retinol product I've tried so far..love all Sunday riley so far
I love this product and mix with Luna for a great night time treatment. My skin loves it!
I got a sample of this product with an order of CEO Afterglow moisturizer. I really like the fact that it makes my sun spots on my face fade.

avis.titre: Best non-prescribed retinol products on the market
avis.texte: A+ High Dose retinol was my stepping stone into getting my skin use to retinols. I started my journey of retinol use with this product, which I still use to this day. On nights I am not using a tretinoin, I alway reach for my tried, and true Sunday Riley's A+ high dose retinol. I have never received so many compliments about how fresh, bright and seamless my skin looked than when I was using this product on the daily basis. You will see results in your skin after 6 weeks of use. My skin did go throw a purging phase and it did cause some dryness. However if you alternate between the A+ retinol and the Good Genes the purging will not be as drastic. However everyone's skin is different. Overall, highly recommend 10/10. It's worth the price.

avis.titre: Highly recommend! It's worth every penny!
avis.texte: The only retinoid serum that doesn't ruin my skin and actually reduces wrinkles!!
This product has zero affect on my skin. The suggested use is every other day to prevent irritation. I've used at least once a day for a week. I have had zero affect, good or bad.
I absolutely love Sunday Riley but it is too expensive. Once my products are gone, I plan to find less expensive alternatives

avis.titre: I love this product! I plan to keep purchasing!
avis.texte: This product is amazing! My face is so soft after wearing it! The dryness has totally gone away, even in this harsh winter weather!

IN LOVE! I haven't used Retinol before but I wanted a product that really was effective in giving me the glow, clarity, and improved texture. I never write product reviews... but had to since I think this is an amazing product. My sister recommended it to me, and I am now in love. Inspiring me to get more of the Sunday Riley products!
Mid-fourties' and live Sunday Riley. This stuff evens and clears rough skin

I've been using this product while "skin cycling." Which means I use it only about once every 4 days, and I still notice a difference in my skin. So much so that others have commented on how nice my skin is.
Great retinol, did not leave me dry. It sank right in. Making huge difference. Love my skin!

avis.titre: definitely a high dose of retinol!
avis.texte: This is a powerful retinol serum that is no joke. I tried easing into it by going every other night, then moved to every night. I ended up with signs of a damaged skin barrier (redness) on my chin. I'm going to lay off this on my chin for a couple weeks, then try again, but stick to every other night. I love that I'm getting a strong dose of an excellent skincare ingredient, but I need to take care not to overdo it.

avis.titre: Love love love…my new nightly go to!
avis.texte: This is my 3rd purchase of the same product…that says a lot. I love good genes for my daily and A+ at night. Started with good genes (I'm obsessed) and then added on others products. Easy with incredible great results. You won't be disappointed.

I'm a 20 year old girl who has suffered from hormonal and regular acne for years and this is this only product that can smooth out my skin in 1 (one) night. It is insane how well this works. Small bumps will be gone overnight. This is labeled as high dose but I have very sensitive skin yet I can use it day and night. I cannot recommend this product enough.
My skin is on the sensitive and I was a little apprehensive about trying this product. I am so happy I got over that because this stuff is ridiculously good and has does wonders for my skin.

Quite honestly though as long as you're using the 1-2 pumps as recommended you won't go through it super fast so it'll last over time. I haven't seen a product work so fast and also so well in a while. I pair this with other products, but this seems to be the one that really changed my skin for the better. I have combination mostly dry sensitive skin and as long as I'm not doing a harsh exfoliant before the serum sits so nicely on my skin.

I currently use Sunday Riley and have added this product to my routine. So far so good. I am following the instructions in the back to ease my skin. I am loving how my skin feels right now. Will revise my comments as i go along.

avis.titre: .5 doesn't even last a full month
avis.texte: I bought the .5 size because it was on sale (thank goodness). But the product didn't even last a full month! I bought the bottle on Dec 2nd and here it is Dec 28 and I'm all out ! I used a pump every night and I'm sure even missed a night or two in between that time. Now I don't mind spending money on good skin care. I typically use Clarins, peach and lily and Sunday Riley to name a few. I don't mind spending the money because the products usually last months before I have to repurchase. Never have I ever had a product last me less than a month. I never even got to see any benefits from using it. When applying, my skin drank it up and felt smooth but I don't see any long term affects of using a retinol. So, I guess I'm just left feeling disappointed.
My 73 yr old skin is visibly tighter since I started using A+ product about three months ago.
I have been using this product now for over a year and I will never use anything else. It has made me skin so smooth and keeps me looking young!

I purchased this on Black Friday after having my eye on it for a few weeks. I was looking to upgrade from the Cerave Resurfacing Retinol and it was half off. I adjusted well and can see the glow it's giving my skin. The full price makes me hesitant though... will have to see how long the bottle lasts me.

This is the first retinol that I have used that does not make my sensitive skin peel and flake... And it's very effective too.. I'm 34 and somehow have no signs of aging yet. I imagine it has a lot to do with the years I've been using this ;-)

I've been using it for almost 2 years now. I see the difference around my eyes, forehead and smile lines. People are amazed when I tell them my age. This product does not smell the best and I do get acne occasionally around my temples. But I feel the pros outweigh the cons.
Love this! Goes on smoothly and absorbs well. I notice an improvement in a few days.

avis.titre: Love A+ High Dose Retinoid Serum
avis.texte: I love A+! I can tell such a difference in my skin texture and appearance.

I'm new into my 30s, and starting to see my face changing, so a few months ago I started using a cheap retinol from another brand to test the retional waters. It was working alright, but I recently took the plunge to transition over to this big girl retional. What a glow up! My skin looks the best it ever has - addressing pores on my nose and chin, fine lines, and overall literally glow-y. I'll absolutely keep up with this one and hope to keep exploring complementary Sunday Riley products!
The best Retinoid I've ever used! Yes this one is pricy but I've gotten ones from the doctor and this one is by far the best.

A+ is an excellent retinoid for aging, mature skin. My skin is brighter and smoother and the fine lines are fading away. I add a few drops of the Luna Night Oil and I have had no sensitivity to either product (I did start out alternating the two products). My skin is dry and this seems to have helped my skin absorb my moisturizer more than it has in the past. Also, my 21 year old daughter has been using it on her acne prone skin. She has had dramatic results. Love it!!!

Absolutely loved this serum from day one! Love the fast absorption rate and I believe it has improved the texture of my skin and pore size. Thankfully, I do not have sensitive skin and can use nightly with my routine along with my other products. I highly recommend recommend this serum.

avis.titre: A perfect Retinoid product - bar none.
avis.texte: One word: indispensable. But to add a bit more commentary as to why this is so indispensable I will say I have highly sensitive and reactive skin (always and I am soon to turn 61 yrs of age) and have found this Retinoid product to be set apart (for me anyway) by its notable efficacy whilst being very gentle. Kudos to Sunday Riley for this product and all others in her line-up. I have come to rely on them exclusively for the entirety of my daily facial skin care regimen.
You have to start off a few days a week and gradually get to every day but WOW the results are great!
So far so good! Great texture and my skin feels amazing the next morning.

I'm torn about this product and how it's helping improve the look and texture of my mature skin problems. I have lots of congestion around my t-zone from using this product in combination with other products from this line.

avis.titre: This seems to be effective and surprisingly non irritating
avis.texte: I purchased the 1 oz but the bottle only seemed 1/2 full - not sure if it was be design
I will not be without this serum; I use it 2x a week followed by CEO Glow and a good moisturizer. Combined with Good Genes, Sunday Riley is pricey but works. Must have.
I really like it but I don't think I can afford it at the regular price. Very expensive.

avis.titre: I will not live without my Sunday Riley products
avis.texte: My skin looks and feels so much better since I started using these products. I have tried many others but these are the best. I have "age spots" and it has lightened it more than a chemical peel did. which was painful. this is my go to products
I will never go a night without this product as long as I live. I tried something cheaper out of curiosity for a week and it was confirmed, nothing leaves my skin looking better than this.

This serum is definitely a keeper for me! I did go through an initial phase of acne purge and slight irritation on the cheekbones but after I stuck with the process of getting my skin used to the product, I couldn't be happier! I am able to use it nightly with no issues but sometimes I use it less during the week. My skin is 99% clear and my fine lines have disappeared. Overall, my skin is also much brighter (less dull).
I'm 65 and have tried every serum available. I always come back to Sunday Riley. A bit pricey, but worth it.
